export_audio_features.thread_evidence: export_presets.cfg preset2 variant/thread_support=false; no explicit audio/general setting in project.godot
export_audio_features.stream_route: BGM and ambience bed explicitly PLAYBACK_TYPE_STREAM. Exact current worklet implements GodotProcessor + RingBuffer. No-thread mode starts via start_nothreads; audio worklet sends read messages, main JS invokes out_callback then posts chunk buffers. Main-thread long tasks can delay refill.
export_audio_features.sample_route: ShortSFX/detail players leave playback_type default; old actual browser observed AudioBufferSourceNode starts (sample route). Do not assume all sources share Godot stream ring; record actual JS node classes/effective playback during new run. SampleNode native buffers use independent browser sample playback and Godot sample buses.
export_audio_features.underflow_implementation: GodotProcessor.process tests output.data_left() >= chunk. If insufficient it skips writing output (zero output quantum), with debug warning commented out. No built-in public underrun count. Engine updates baseLatency+outputLatency once/s; neither reports underrun by itself.

independent_ambience_ab.recommended_diagnostic_action: At known stable live context, retain SelectedAmbienceRuntime node; set_process(false) then _clear_context(). This stops HomeLife scheduler/disconnects ownership signals and clears owned GameAmbience only. Before first activation, suppress runtime attachment/activation at an explicit diagnosis switch instead. Enabling again requires explicit runtime/context setup, not calling scene-wide stop.
independent_ambience_ab.must_verify: Capture before/after node identities,12SFX voices, Music voices/stream paths, requested_track/starts, audio_profile, sessionVolume, bus mute/gain, tree pause, gameplay seed/input/camera/resolution. Music must keep progressing, SFX accepted play+native source start/PCM remains reproducible, ambience beds/details count0 and scheduler off. Repeaton/off/on in same scene and returnHome->plains->forest; one-time clear must not auto-reactivate.

HomeLife.set_mode(original) alone: outer Selected runtime may reactivate HomeA/life.
stop_regional_cues: calls stop_director_cues() without origin filter and stops original regional cues.

measurement_layers.metrics: Monotonic event sequence, simulation tick, epoch/owner, eventID/cueID, realTime; coin also accepted/claimed/walletDelta; attemptedAudio++ before dispatch. Separate accepted gameplay from cue call and from successful audio allocation. No gameplay RNG/wallet writes for metrics.

Every audio return path records one reason: invalidOrigin/service, unknownCue, shutdown,mute,treePause,debounce,idQuota,poolFull,assetLoad,suppressed/outOfRange,ownerExpired; accepted++, voiceID, streamPath, profile, bus, active12pool snapshot, startSeq. Conservation attempted=accepted+rejected; preemptions counted separately with victim startSeq. Existing played/director_dropped/weapon_dropped cannot reconstruct all these reasons.

Hook AudioBufferSourceNode.start/stop before engine boots; call native first then record successful call or exception, contextID/state, currentTime/performance.now, when/offset/rate/loop, stream PCM fingerprint(sampleRate/channels/length+hash), sourceID and onended. Nonzero source buffer + start is scheduling evidence, not final PCM or audibility. Do not identify coin only by0.522s duration. STREAM BGM/bed has no per-clip native BufferSource start; observe Godot voice state+ring instead.

Fan out source/bus outputs into AudioWorklet meter with a silent connected sink while preserving original destination edges. Aggregate per render quantum (typically128frames) into0.1-1s RMS/peak/nonzero/silence-run, sample-frame timestamps and clippingFrames; record all original direct-destination branches and sum aligned sample frames if claiming graph mixed output. Capture exact-asset per-source PCM or aligned known-cue fingerprint to distinguish coin from active BGM. A nonzero mixed stream cannot prove coin played; zero mixed output during intentional silence is not underrun.

Diagnostic copy/intercept exact worklet module only: count before super.process whenever running && output!=null && outputs[0] valid && output.data_left()<channels*quantumFrames. Aggregate totalQuanta,readyQuanta,underrunQuanta,underrunFrames,underrunMs=frames/sampleRate*1000,maxConsecutiveQuanta,minAvailableSamples,minAvailableMs=avail/channels/sampleRate*1000,ringCapacityFrames,chunkArrivalFrames/gaps,threadsMode. Exclude not-yet-initialized output. Count in worklet time/currentFrame; publish aggregates at most1Hz to avoid main-thread instrumentation causing dropouts. Existing commented engine warning marks exact branch; no timing/PCM rewrite necessary. Do not replace existing onmessage; fan out with addEventListener or compatible wrapper and preserve all engine read/chunk messages.

Record context.state changes, sampleRate, baseLatency, outputLatency, getOutputTimestamp when supported, visibility/focus/page suspension and actual output device; use physical-device system/loopback audio recording for end-to-end continuity/heard cue. Graph PCM plus running context cannot prove DAC/speaker or player audibility. Real device remains unverified here.

findings: Exact diagnostic STREAM counters directly confirm heavy underflow in Home baseline (first3baseline90.95%,91.05%,91.58%), consistent with actual mixed graph silence. This is stronger than previous inferred queue starvation; counters conserve requested=read+underrun.

all_audio_off stops active players and services and suppresses the explicit coin with diagnostic_all_audio_off; PCM100%zero is expected. Underlying running WebAudio driver/ring still exists and can underflow delivering silence. Therefore control removes active voices/decoding/service processing, not all browser audio driver costs. HomeFPS does not improve in this Cloud run.

web_sample_audio uses actual type2 sample voices with nearly real-time playback-position progress, unlike STREAM. Native nonzero long-buffer start is scheduling proof only. Current observed destination PCM is100%zero and only1originalbranch appears: sample output graph coverage/routing unresolved. Do not claim candidate audibility/continuous final mixed PCM.

Potential official sample Master bus route bug: set_sample_bus_send invalid sendIndex falls backBus0; if busIndex0 receives this it calls Master.setSend(Master), disconnecting destination and making a direct feedback cycle. Static mechanism plausible; current data does not expose actual bus assignments, so not yet confirmed. Need explicit graph edges/connect-disconnect audit in separately identified diagnostics.

Home sample bed24s restarts at the same nonzero initial seek offset (9.488s then9.488s, second candidate7.1173s then7.1173s), potentially looping only tail. Native.loop=false is expected for engine custom looping and alone not a failure. Derived scheduling gaps for repeated-offset bed starts are approximately0.43585s and0.09983s, not isolated PCM silence measurements. Original loop equivalence unverified.

Official Sample.getAudioBuffer always duplicates complete registeredAudioBuffer via per-channel temporaryFloat32Array and new ctx.createBuffer+copyToChannel; SampleNode construction/_restart call it. Home BGM7785215frames stereoFloat32=62281720B;24s bed1058400frames stereoFloat32=8467200B; single-copy sum70748920B=67.47MiB. Registered base+active source copies alone about134.94MiB, plus transient channel copies, Wasm decode, retained old sources, other songs and cache. Actual aggregate memory not measured by existing Godot RENDER_BUFFER/TEXTURE_MEM counters.

Baseline Home detail accepted1 can cause8native1s same-buffer starts (row3), consistent with repeated stream_paused=false resetting sample source. Guard stage with no newly accepted detail cannot prove detail restart fix solely from absence of restarts: require a phase containing accepted detail or explicit detail fixture and match expected1start.
